patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Comparison thesis: Same category, different company size. Choose Fastmail only if your buying job matches “Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addre” rather than Cisco Webex's shape. Choose Cisco Webex only if your buying job matches “Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Ca” rather than Fastmail's shape. Workflow advantage: Fastmail leans shared coverage; Cisco Webex leans business-phone, contact-center. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Fastmail is Privacy-focused business email, calendar and contacts with custom domains and shared addresses — Business Basic from $3/user/month annual; a; Cisco Webex is Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Calling and Contact Center often quote-layered..
- Company-size focus: Fastmail (micro, small-business) vs Cisco Webex (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Fastmail-leaning — vs Cisco Webex-leaning business-phone, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Fastmail — Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; Cisco Webex — Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic.

Limitations — Fastmail: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications; Shared addresses, shared calendars and the shared address book require Standard or above; Cisco Webex: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors.

Poor-fit cases: Fastmail is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone, WhatsApp or team-chat product — adjacent to business communications · Cisco Webex is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic · Avoid Fastmail if you actually need Cisco Webex's motion (Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
